title: Add hierarchical task groups and dependency visibility
description:
Improve pi-tasks so related work is understandable and navigable instead of appearing as a flat list. Model parent/child relationships separately from blocked-by dependencies, preserve backend-native relationship data where available, and provide a hierarchical list mode that hides children until their parent is expanded. Show the specific blocker tasks—not only a blocked icon—in list/detail context. Support sq first, then map the same domain model to beads and nested TODO.md checklists where practical.

Acceptance criteria:
- Task domain and adapter API expose parent/child and blocker references without conflating hierarchy with readiness.
- sq reads/writes blocked_by and stores any pi-tasks-owned hierarchy metadata under metadata.pi_tasks.
- The list can toggle between flat and grouped modes; grouped mode shows roots and expandable, indented descendants.
- Blocked rows/details identify blocker refs/titles and distinguish active from resolved blockers.
- Selection, search, create/edit, status/priority/type actions remain correct while grouping or expanding.
- TODO.md nested checklist items round-trip as parent/child tasks without treating description bullets as children.
- Backend capability gaps degrade explicitly and safely.
- Automated tests cover relationship normalization, tree projection, dependency labels, backend mapping, and key intents; README documents the interaction.
